subject.title: Feature: Activity-aware run timeout (wall-clock timeout kills active multi-tool runs)

question: Should OpenClaw change `agents.defaults.timeoutSeconds` from one hard run budget into separate idle/liveness and absolute maximum timeout semantics, and what default/upgrade behavior should ship?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes core runtime semantics and likely config/default behavior, so automation should not choose the product contract on its own.

options.title: Add idle plus max semantics
options.body: Introduce a liveness/idle timeout alongside a hard maximum cap, with explicit docs and compatibility-safe defaults.

options.title: Reset the existing budget on activity
options.body: Treat `timeoutSeconds` as an activity timeout, reducing config surface but changing existing hard-budget meaning.

options.title: Keep hard wall clock only
options.body: Land only notice/progress mitigations and keep long active turns controlled by higher configured budgets.

recommendation.title: Add idle plus max semantics
recommendation.body: Introduce a liveness/idle timeout alongside a hard maximum cap, with explicit docs and compatibility-safe defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway and embedded-runner history plus timeline mentions make this the best available product-direction owner from the inspected signals.
